content.title: Why Carvana (CVNA) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of online used car dealer Carvana (NYSE: CVNA) jumped 1.7% in the afternoon session after Jefferies upgraded the stock to 'Buy' from 'Hold' and raised its price target. The analyst also increased the price target on the shares to $475 from $385. The upgrade was based on signs that Carvana could gain a larger share of the used-car market more quickly as shoppers shifted to online purchasing.
